title: Confidence-Gated Blind Fallback for Non-Separable Weak Sources
novelty_claim: Turn the failed 'better ranker' story into a new claim: the startup front end should detect when analog evidence is too weak to justify a winner-take-all commit, abstain, and fall back to blind packet isolation. The novelty is confidence-aware refusal to over-infer, not generic source-aware startup or lower startup voltage.
closest_prior_art: A fully integrated 28nm CMOS dual source adaptive thermoelectric and RF energy harvesting circuit with 110mV startup voltage (2018)
A High-Efficiency Dual-Polarity Thermoelectric Energy-Harvesting Interface Circuit With Cold Startup and Fast-Searching ZCD (2022)
A self-powered multi-input OSECE interface circuit for multiple piezoelectric transducers (2024)
Self-Powered Collaborative Energy Harvesting Interface Circuit for Stacked Multiple Piezoelectric Elements (2024)
Multi-Source Energy Harvesting Systems Integrated in Silicon: A Comprehensive Review (2025)
differentiation: Do not sell this as another smarter selector. The claim only survives if the circuit explicitly detects non-separable source evidence using a low-energy separability metric and delays ranking until the margin clears; otherwise it behaves like the already-validated blind packet gate.
easiest_falsifier: Kill it if the confidence-gated variant never beats `source_blind` on the near-tie slices under equal pre-handoff energy accounting.
evidence_plan: Reuse the existing packet-gated scaffold and compare only three designs: `source_blind`, `time_constant_ranked`, and one confidence-gated fallback variant.
Constrain the first matrix to near-tie cases that the scouts identify as unresolved: small `VOC` offsets, `1:1` to `1:3` impedance spread, and unequal or late-arrival ramps.

Score `startup_ok`, `t_handoff`, `e_ctrl`, abstain-to-commit transitions, and whether the confidence node suppresses false winner commits only after reconciling the written `startup_ok` contract with explicit handoff events.
Keep packet-gating mechanism claims bounded until a same-scaffold no-packet control exists; do not use this lane to reopen the killed broad H1 story.
Stop immediately if the gain disappears once the same measurement hooks and equal accounting are applied.

budget_envelope.routing: Champion lane. Stay inside `H1_multisource_cold_start` and do not reopen broad startup or MPPT searches.
budget_envelope.literature_gate: Targeted overlap check only, <=6 papers or review sections focused on abstention-like pre-handoff controls.
budget_envelope.simulation_gate: One scaffold, one added confidence node, <=16 near-tie cases, no topology proliferation.
budget_envelope.promotion_rule: Promote only if it shows a clean win over `source_blind` on the near-tie matrix with equal overhead.
budget_envelope.kill_rule: Kill if it collapses to another smarter selector or if `source_blind` already saturates the target cases.

title: Restart-Scrub Handoff Controller for Repeated Collapse and Partial-Store Memory
novelty_claim: Shift the contribution from first-handoff startup to restart correctness: a handoff controller that scrubs stale winner state, quarantines collapsing sources, and rearms only after both source ports and the store recover. The interesting claim is correct second and third starts under partial brownout memory, not another UVLO cleanup.
closest_prior_art: Brownout / repeated-collapse / restart-safe intermittent-power supervisor literature (exact claim matrix still missing in the scout set)
Plain fixed hysteretic restart paths with stale-state scrub
The current `source_blind` packet-gate family, which is only well-characterized for first handoff
differentiation: Do not frame this as chatter suppression or another one-shot cold-start controller. It survives only if restart correctness after collapse is measurably better than both a fixed hysteretic scrub baseline and the current blind packet-gate path.
easiest_falsifier: Kill it if a simple fixed hysteretic path with stale-state scrub matches the restart behavior once equal control-energy accounting is restored.
evidence_plan: Extend the existing falsifier deck past first handoff and force repeated collapse and recovery windows with partial store memory.
Compare one restart-scrub controller against `source_blind` and a fixed hysteretic scrub baseline on `startup_ok`, `fall_count`, `rise2_ok`, restart latency, and restart-control energy.
Use the current measurement hooks only after they are checked against explicit re-arm and second-rise events so the metric contract matches the written claim.
Treat the missing restart-literature claim matrix as a blocker; if the focused overlap screen already covers this behavior, stop instead of polishing the circuit.

budget_envelope.routing: Backup lane. Keep inactive unless the champion is killed or saturates.
budget_envelope.literature_gate: One focused pass, <=6 papers, only to resolve restart-safe intermittent-power overlap.
budget_envelope.simulation_gate: One controller variant, <=12 repeated-collapse cases, same hooks and accounting as the active H1 lane.
budget_envelope.promotion_rule: Promote only if restart correctness improves over both baselines without drifting into generic supervisor territory.
budget_envelope.kill_rule: Kill if the benefit reduces to a standard hysteretic scrub path or if the literature screen closes the gap.

title: Reverse-Port Sentinel Isolation Under Device-Faithful Leakage and Body Paths
novelty_claim: Only pursue this if realistic parasitics reopen the anti-backdrive question: a source-referenced reverse-port sentinel plus gated isolation that detects wrong-way energization before it propagates. The novelty would come from solving a device-faithful failure mode that the current idealized decks hide, not from generic anti-backdrive rhetoric.
closest_prior_art: Reverse-current-blocking / power-supply-switch / ideal-diode literature for energy harvesting and intermittent systems
The current blind packet-gate implementation under idealized leakage and routing assumptions
differentiation: Do not activate this as a generic anti-backdrive block. It only survives if finite off-isolation, body paths, charge injection, and routing asymmetry expose failures that a simpler back-to-back switch cannot close.
easiest_falsifier: Kill it if a plain back-to-back switch matches the result once realistic parasitics and equal overhead accounting are introduced.
evidence_plan: Replace the near-ideal switch assumptions with a bounded parasitic envelope covering leakage, body-diode behavior, charge injection, and route asymmetry.
Compare only three cases: plain back-to-back isolation, current `source_blind`, and one reverse-port sentinel variant.
Report `e_backdrive`, false source re-energization events, and startup success under the same control-monitor path used elsewhere in H1.
Do not promote unless the gap appears under realistic parasitics and remains after the simpler isolation control is added.

budget_envelope.routing: Contingent third lane. Keep parked unless the first two lanes fail and the benchmark auditor confirms the parasitic gap is still open.
budget_envelope.literature_gate: Targeted overlap check only, <=6 papers or sections on reverse-current blocking and power-path isolation.
budget_envelope.simulation_gate: One parasitic envelope, <=12 cases, no new architecture family.
budget_envelope.promotion_rule: Promote only if the device-faithful model reveals a new correctness gap that the simple back-to-back path cannot match.
budget_envelope.kill_rule: Kill if the issue is only a modeling artifact or if the simple isolation baseline closes the gap.
